description.en: Complete usage reference for the 63 workflow operators in Browser Copilot, including variables, data tables, loops, downloads, secrets, and AI features.
description.zh: Browser Copilot 的 63 个工作流算子完整使用文档，涵盖变量、数据表、循环、下载、凭证与 AI 能力。

description.en: Build, run, debug, and export your first Browser Copilot workflow.
description.zh: 创建、运行、调试并导出你的第一个 Browser Copilot 工作流。

description.en: Variables, interpolation, the data table, ports, loops, error handling, files, secrets, AI features, and triggers.
description.zh: 变量、插值、数据表、端口、循环、错误处理、文件、凭证、AI 能力与触发器。

description.en: Click, read, fill, scroll, upload, and inject JavaScript on the page with 14 interaction operators.
description.zh: 使用 14 个页面交互算子完成点击、读取、填写、滚动、上传与脚本注入。

description.en: Tabs, windows, history, screenshots, downloads, cookies, and OCR with 18 browser operators.
description.zh: 使用 18 个浏览器算子处理标签页、窗口、历史、截图、下载、Cookie 与 OCR。

description.en: Triggers, sub-workflows, HTTP requests, notifications, exports, groups, and AI agents with 13 general operators.
description.zh: 使用 13 个通用算子处理触发器、子工作流、HTTP 请求、通知、导出、分组与 AI Agent。

description.en: Variables, regex, sorting, mapping, table rows, secrets, and spreadsheet parsing with 11 data operators.
description.zh: 使用 11 个数据算子处理变量、正则、排序、映射、表格行、凭证与电子表格解析。

description.en: Branches, element checks, while loops, data loops, element loops, repeats, and loop breakpoints.
description.zh: 条件分支、元素判断、While 循环、数据循环、元素循环、重复任务与循环断点。
